name: @onegrid/studio
description: Headless Postgres table-editor engine — the logic behind a Supabase-style database studio with no rendering attached. Rich schema introspection over pg_catalog, a DdlOperation union that compiles to correctly-quoted DDL, primary-key-aware row DML, foreign-key relationship intelligence, a migration planner with risk assessment and reversal, and a dollar-quote-aware SQL statement splitter. Runs over an injectable queryable, so it carries no database driver.
